name: Precision Food Equipment LLC.
old_description: Specializing in slicer repair, Precision Food Equipment has been servicing satisfied return customers like Arby's, Wildflower Bread Company, Claim Jumper, YC's Mongolian Grill and many more all across Arizona for years.  We are always focused on customer service satisfaction and offer a satisfaction guarantee.  We only offer services that meet the highest industry standards and our staff is fully trained and qualified.  As you may have noticed, appliances aren’t as dependable as they were in the days of our parents and grandparents but you can be sure that we can fix your appliance right the first time and get it to operate like new again!
about:
Precision Food Equipment LLC operates from Gilbert, Arizona, where it was founded on April 5, 2008 by Jason Hertel. The company began as a family-owned venture built on the principle that honest, reasonably priced service helps restaurants and delis succeed. Hertel started the business after observing that many foodservice operators were overpaying for mediocre repairs that often failed to resolve the underlying problem.

The firm specializes in repair and preventive maintenance for commercial food preparation and cooking equipment. Technicians service all makes and models of slicers, mixers, meat choppers, grinders, bread and bagel slicers, vegetable choppers, warmers, and Amana commercial microwaves. Work is performed both on-site via mobile service and in the company's shop. Precision Food Equipment is also the authorized Arizona service location for the EZPRO 120 ventless deep fryer.

Customers span the foodservice industry, including quick-service chains, independent restaurants, delis, and concession operators. Named accounts include Arby's, Wildflower Bread Company, Claim Jumper, and YC's Mongolian Grill, all served across Arizona. Preventive maintenance plans are customized to each operation, focusing on safety, food waste reduction, production quality, and minimizing unplanned downtime.

The company differentiates itself by routing calls directly to factory-trained technicians, typically providing same-day or next-day service. A satisfaction guarantee backs every repair, and the business model emphasizes transparent scheduling — if technicians are booked, customers are informed upfront and offered alternatives.

about:
Precision Metals Inc operates a full-service metal fabrication shop in Benson, North Carolina, serving contractors across eastern North Carolina including Wake, Johnston, and Harnett counties. The company focuses on custom metal fabrication for roofing companies and general contractors.

The shop produces metal roofing, gutters, coping, edge metal, chimney caps, and metal roofing accessories. Its fabrication processes include plasma cutting on a plasma table capable of cutting aluminum, steel, and copper, as well as folding using Schechtl brakes for single or small pieces. The company emphasizes low lead times and fast service on both commercial and residential projects.

Customers range from roofing companies and general contractors to commercial building owners and homeowners associations; one noted project involved the Topsail Armes homeowners association at Topsail Beach. The firm supplies custom metal trim packages for commercial metal roofing and steep-slope metal roofing systems.

Precision Metals differentiates itself by offering free estimates, quick turnaround on customized orders, and a shorter lead time than many competitors, with the ability to fabricate customized metal pieces that other shops cannot.

name: Precision Metalworks LLC
old_description: Founded with a passion for turning ideas into reality, Precision Metalworks began as a part-time endeavor in 2019, driven by a love for craftsmanship and the art of creating unique welding projects. What started as a small-scale venture has since evolved into the creation of remarkable structural masterpieces, proudly serving some of the most renowned food processing plants.
about:
Precision Metalworks LLC operates from a shop on Dunbar Street in Fremont, Nebraska. The business began in 2019 as a part-time, after-hours welding venture — one person, one machine, and a reputation to build. Founder Max Bieker still answers the phone himself.

The shop provides mobile and in-house welding and fabrication across stainless steel, aluminum, and mild steel (22-gauge sheet to structural plate). Equipment includes a MultiCam 3000 waterjet with KMT pump, an Amada shear, an Amada press brake, Syncrowave AC/DC TIG, and MIG welders. Services span mobile welding (farm equipment breakdowns, trailer repair, structural on-site), repair welding (buckets, blades, heavy machinery, sanitary/food-grade equipment, aluminum castings), and custom fabrication (brackets, racks, guards, frames, waterjet cutting, shearing, forming). The in-house capability avoids subcontracting, shortening lead times and keeping one person accountable.

Primary customers include food processing plants requiring sanitary stainless work, agricultural operations needing equipment and trailer repair, and industrial clients with heavy machinery or structural welding needs. The service area covers eastern Nebraska — Fremont, Omaha, Blair, Wahoo, and surrounding communities — with travel for larger jobs.

The company deliberately mixes food-plant tolerance work with farm and trailer repairs, applying the same precision to both at a small-shop price. The founding idea was to deliver plant-grade quality without the runaround, from someone who picks up the phone.

name: Precision PCB | Precision Technologies, Inc.
old_description: Quick Turn PCB and Assembly by Certified Manufacturing Experts -
about:
Precision PCB, operating as Precision Technologies, Inc., has been headquartered in Elgin, Illinois since its founding in 1998. The company provides electronics manufacturing services with a focus on printed circuit board fabrication, assembly, and design.

The shop offers quick-turn PCB fabrication — double-sided boards delivered next morning when files arrive by 9 a.m. EST, multilayers in 48 hours — and prototype assembly in 24–48 hours via turnkey or consignment models. Capabilities span HDI, rigid‑flex, RF/microwave, and semiconductor PCBs, with SMT placement down to 0201 packages, BGA/QFN/DFN/LGA attachment, and IPC‑A‑610 Class III inspection. Production runs from prototype through medium volume, leveraging both domestic and offshore fabrication partners.

Customers span defense and aerospace, automotive, LED lighting, industrial, test and measurement, medical devices, transportation, and networking/AI infrastructure. The company positions itself as a single‑point‑of‑contact partner for engineers and buyers seeking a consolidated design‑to‑assembly workflow.

Precision PCB emphasizes its “One‑Stop Solution” — integrating CAM engineering, fabrication, and assembly under one roof — along with ITAR registration, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a Cage code (7T6D9) to serve regulated sectors. Domestic production and a 26‑year track record are cited as foundations for reliability and speed.

about:
Precision Resistive Products (PRP) operates from Mediapolis, Iowa, where it has served the electronics industry for over 47 years. The company's founding year and original owners are not publicly disclosed, but its longevity points to a stable, privately held operation.

PRP manufactures a broad line of precision resistors in both leaded and surface-mount formats. Its portfolio spans thin-film, wire-wound, thick-film, metal-film, power, metal-strip, shunt, current-sense, surge, pulse-withstanding, and metal-oxide technologies. Recent additions include the GMR Series of aluminum-housed power wire-wound resistors (5–300 W) and the AEC-Q200-qualified PTNF Series tantalum-nitride thin-film chip resistors, alongside the PR9544 ultra-precise thin-film network chip, the PR9372 leaded metal-film audio resistor, and the GP Series general-purpose metal-film parts.

The company explicitly targets automotive applications with its AEC-Q200-compliant PTNF Series, indicating a focus on the automotive electronics supply chain. Beyond automotive, its standard and non-standard resistor values serve a range of OEMs and design engineers across industrial, instrumentation, and consumer electronics markets, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

PRP emphasizes “Dedicated to Excellence” as its guiding principle, highlighting high quality, competitive pricing, and quick delivery as differentiators for its newer product lines. The firm also maintains compliance documentation and cross-reference tools to support customer procurement.

about:
Hospital Supply & O2 Solutions operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, as a division of Hospital Supply. The company provides respiratory care and durable medical equipment to patients and hospitals throughout the state.

The business focuses on two core service lines: sleep apnea therapy and home oxygen therapy. For sleep apnea, it supplies CPAP, VPAP, and APAP devices along with nasal, pillow, and full-face masks. For oxygen therapy, it offers portable oxygen concentrators, oxygen cylinders, stationary concentrators, and nebulizers. The company works directly with prescribing sleep physicians, receiving prescriptions and qualifying documents, then schedules in-person appointments with a respiratory therapist to review the sleep study, demonstrate equipment use, and explain insurance billing.

Customers include individual patients referred by sleep specialists, hospitals, and insurance providers across New Mexico. The company serves the broader healthcare, respiratory care, sleep medicine, and home healthcare sectors.
